items.evidence: Log shows 19 uL master mix (106 water/40 buffer/4 dNTP/2 Q5 for 8 rxns), 2.5 uL each primer, 1 uL template per well with correct primer/template mapping, e.g. lines 30-43.

Comment gives 98C 30s, 34-36 cycles, annealing 30s, 72C, 5 min final; log shows 19 uL water, 5 uL rCutSmart, 1 uL DpnI per well (lines 184-193), then 37C 30 min/65C 20 min comment and a pause for column clean-up.
Log lines 310-342: 6 uL water, 2 uL T4 buffer, fragments 3/2/3/2 uL, 2 uL enzyme mix with mixing in A1 (same for B1-D1), totalling 20 uL.
Golden Gate program comment, 42C 60s, 250 uL LB recovery and kanamycin plating are present, but assembly clean-up is stated as eluting in 15 uL water rather than the paper's 10 uL.
Every move() picks up a fresh tip and drops it; the log shows pick-up/drop pairs throughout with no tip-less pipetting and no leftover tip.

judge.summary: The protocol follows the paper for PCR setup, DpnI digestion and assembly mixes, and it handles tips cleanly. It fails the cycling and transformation item because the assembly clean-up is eluted in 15 µL water instead of the paper's 10 µL.
